Settings.AiExtractionInstructions: Choose the source in which the case number or reference appears most clearly.
Settings.AiSystemPrompt: Create a rule for a recurring stream of similar emails from one example email. Use only stable characteristics, base every choice on the example data, and do not invent information.
Settings.AiMetadataPrompt: Provide a short general rule name and description. State the specific purpose and omit variable names, numbers, dates, locations, and references.
Settings.AiSenderPrompt: Use a fixed functional sender address as a condition, but not a personal address that may send multiple types of email.
Settings.AiSubjectPrompt: Choose the shortest literal text that identifies the recurring type or purpose and omit variable data.
Settings.AiAttachmentPrompt: Use only a stable part of a filename or a distinctive extension; omit variable data from the recognition value.
Settings.AiFolderPrompt: Provide a short English folder name for the specific email type, without variable data or path characters.
